title: 대법관후보추천위원회 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2 (Functions)
The Recommendation Committee shall recommend persons as candidates for recommendation for appointment as Justices of the Supreme Court (hereinafter referred to as "candidates") in response to consultation by the Chief Justice of the Supreme Court concerning the selection of persons to be recommended for appointment as Justices of the Supreme Court under Article 104 (2) of the Constitution.
